ideas.pitch: An enterprise AI agent that fights wrongful health insurance claim denials by grounding every rebuttal in the insurer's exact policy document.
ideas.title: AegisPolicy AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of solving a personal or universal pain point (dealing with insurance denials) with a robust LLM agent workflow, fitting the HealthTech track.

ideas.pitch: A localized biomedical IoT monitoring system for post-operative patient vitals featuring edge computing and secure telemetry.
ideas.title: MediEdge IoT
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the unusual physical build and genuinely hard engineering pattern from HardHack winners, which immediately stands out in online software-heavy submissions.

ideas.pitch: An automated Anti-Money Laundering risk detection and transaction investigation platform using graph intelligence and explainable ML.
ideas.title: GraphGuard AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the FinTech and Open Innovation intersection with mathematically sound graph algorithms, mimicking the technical depth of the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: A real-time computer vision and classification pipeline analyzing athletic biomechanics using MediaPipe Pose and confidence gating.
ideas.title: PoseStrike Biomechanics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features a working live video demo processing frame-by-frame data, matching the winning execution strategy of the NeuroForge Hackathon champion.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace settling transactions via secure smart contract escrow on a high-speed execution layer.
ideas.title: AgentEscrow Market
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines Web3 infrastructure with autonomous agent utility, directly emulating the Synthesis Hackathon 1st place winner.
